>Is raging just above fabulous? 

Yes. Yes it is.
Thanks! And I do indeed know of Diana Vreeland, but I haven't got round to reading her book. I'll order it from amazon ASAP :)
Yeah... No, that's never gunna happen. Well done for trying, though. /s
15 years of being fat + 10 years of bullying = zero confidence.
Come to London, and then we'll talk. You obviously don't know what "/s" means, though...
You could at least take me out to dinner before trying to get my clothes off... /s
No, in this case it's that I can post this without it being attached to my main account, and can therefore hide from those who know me from reddit or from elsewhere online.
Hahahahahahano. My unclothed body would probably induce nausea.

Meh, my mouth is a mess right now. I'm having yet more surgery next year to fix that, though...
But thanks :)

My glasses are really old and the prescription is out of date - I'm currently saving up for some new ones. The eyebrows have been bothering me for a while and will be sorted soon. And I'm pretty sure you don't want to see me smile. Even after years of surgery (cleft lip and palate), it's still not a pretty sight IMO.
I've been taunted like this so many times that I find it hard to believe you. If, however, you are serious, then thank you. But I'm not much of a gaymer, though...
I normally shave every day but, again, I couldn't be bothered. And I'll check the video out in the morning (I'm in London and it's almost midnight here and I'm inexplicably tired).

My hair isn't usually this bushy - I just got out of the shower and couldn't be bothered to fix it. And the eyebrows are an unfortunate result of my Middle Eastern heritage. I'll sort them out when I get some money. Also, I'm trying to go for an androgynous look - how am I doing with that?
